She smiles widely at the camera, then looks surprised, touching her cheek. The background features a large grey curtain and a glimpse of a balcony. (2) A quick cut shows a group of three children jumping and playing in the same living room next to a large, white L-shaped leather sofa. A man's hand enters from the right holding a yellow Pikachu plushie. (3) The camera zooms in on an old, beige fabric sofa showing signs of wear and a red/blue pillow. Then cuts back to the woman in the pink apron, gesturing with her hands towards the new white sofa. (4) Two men in black uniforms are seen carrying a section of the white leather sofa through a hallway and placing it in the living room. A large white dog walks past. (5) The woman sits on the new sofa, demonstrating the adjustable headrest. A man's hands appear, pressing the headrest and showing its flexibility. (6) The man, wearing a green shirt and yellow cap, moves individual sections of the sofa to show it can be separated. The kids and dog interact in the background. (7) A close-up shot of a white handheld remote with various icons is shown. A thumb presses the buttons, and the sofa sections adjust. (8) The woman lies back on the sofa in a reclined position, looking relaxed. Finally, the whole family (woman and three kids) sit together on the sofa with the dog nearby, smiling and waving.
